svg.title: Arcade 8x8 ASCII SVG bitmap font
svg.desc: Self-contained SVG font covering ASCII 32 through 127. Glyphs advance on an 8x8 grid and draw inside a 7x7 pixel matrix.
svg.text: ASCII 32-127, 8px advance, visible strokes constrained to a 7x7 pixel matrix.
The quick brown fox jumps over lazy dogs.
